verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services. The CLI can configure MCP for agents in one command. Railway is a cloud platform rather than an agent, so the server axis applies, and its own MCP-client connectors are not credited here. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, detailed setup/transport/auth documentation for connecting specific agent clients

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Build with Railway using Agent Skills and the MCP server for AI-powered workflows.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
Install the Railway CLI and configure agent support — skills, MCP, and authentication — in one command.
